adjudication.rationale: The diff adds new “Groups area” styles in `admin_base.scss` that use multiple `!important` overrides: `.groups .ac-wrap { width: 100% !important; }`, `.groups .ac-wrap .item { margin-right: 0 !important; }`, and `.groups .next, .groups .previous { color: #333 !important; }` (plus the disabled color). These are maintainability/scoping concerns introduced by the change (overriding specificity via `!important` rather than adjusting selectors/structure), but they don’t constitute a functional defect by themselves.
